objective: Record a cross-disciplinary, evidence-based review of the current ZTF Classifier blockers, remediation commits, workflow outcomes, scientific limitations and next acceptance gates.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The repository uses a protected v0.2.0 scientific baseline and a 42-feature contract.
CPVS Issue #170 remains an unresolved membership-reconstruction blocker.
StarEmbed Issue #210 and PR #290 contain an independent-input experiment, not classifier-performance validation.
DR24 Issue #253 and AOIC Issue #249 define separate source-acquisition and source-identity workstreams.
Issue #282 tracks recovery and independent authentication of the original production model artifact.
CIN Issue #251 is an optional human-in-the-loop subsystem and must not delay the Park MVP.

baseline.scope: Documentation-only cross-cutting review; no production code, model, data or acceptance criteria changed.

change.proposed: Add Session 09 as a traceable cross-disciplinary review of the latest verified repository, workflow, artifact and primary-source evidence.
change.scope: One think-tank review document and one cumulative lifecycle record on a research branch.
change.rationale: The current state spans multiple scientific and engineering workstreams. A consolidated evidence ledger is needed to prevent stale status, false closure and accidental coupling of unrelated blockers.

expected_improvement: Separate verified facts, partial evidence, failed runs and unresolved hypotheses.
Record remediation actually applied and distinguish it from work still pending.
Preserve the scientific baseline and independent acceptance criteria.
Provide a dependency-aware sequence for the next review cycle.

correctness.before: Status was distributed across issues, PR descriptions, workflow outputs and earlier think-tank sessions.
correctness.after: A single Session 09 document records the current evidence and explicitly marks unresolved gates.

reproducibility.before: No consolidated review linked the latest CPVS, StarEmbed, DR24, AOIC, model artifact and security evidence.
reproducibility.after: The review links the relevant GitHub issues, PRs, workflow runs, artifacts and primary sources. No raw data or credentials are included.
reproducibility.evidence: Session 09 references and linked workflow artifacts.

reliability.before: Several earlier status notes were stale or described workflows as pending after completion.
reliability.after: The review records completed, failed, pending and unverified states separately; it does not infer scientific validity from CI.

evidence: The document was created on a research branch and fetched again by exact repository path and commit.
Current CPVS full-parent and MGPR workflow metadata and the MGPR artifact were inspected.
The CPVS 100-object lineage workflow failure was verified from its job log.
StarEmbed PR #290 current branch commits and prior CI/lifecycle outcomes were inspected.
DR24 ObservationService and API source files were inspected on main.
The report explicitly identifies simulated expert roles and does not claim external human peer review.
validation.blocker: This documentation review does not close any scientific or product acceptance gate. Each underlying issue retains its own acceptance criteria.

root_causes: The CPVS 11,602-object membership discrepancy has not been explained by a documented publisher selection rule.
The 100-object coordinate/epoch lineage workflow failed before data analysis.
StarEmbed source split duplicates and cross-split overlap remain unresolved.
The frozen v0.2.0 production model artifact has not been independently recovered and authenticated.
The normal application observation path still uses ALeRCE by default; DR24 raw acquisition is not yet a validated inference path.
limitations: The 16-seat review uses simulated expert roles and is not external human peer review.
Some PR checks were inspected on preceding heads; fresh current-head checks remain required.
The report does not claim model accuracy, scientific discovery, product readiness or release acceptance.

findings: Engineering CI success and scientific validation are separate acceptance layers.
An empirical predicate that matches reference membership is not proof of the publisher's algorithm.
Source-native survey IDs must remain distinct from astrophysical identity.
The Park MVP, CPVS research and optional CIN runtime must remain separate delivery tracks.
Unverified model artifacts must remain UNKNOWN rather than be reconstructed or substituted.

open_blockers: Complete the CPVS 100-object raw/Table2 coordinate and epoch trace.
Resolve the raw epoch scale using exact pinned bytes and rerun dependent analyses if needed.
Complete StarEmbed CI and source-backed audit, then resolve duplicate and split-overlap lineage.
Recover and independently authenticate the original v0.2.0 production model artifact.
Complete DR24 normalized application integration and independent identity validation.
Re-review all changes on their final PR heads before any merge or release.

knowledge_carried_forward: Preserve v0.2.0, the 42-feature contract, class order and benchmark.
Keep Issue #170 open and PR #285 Draft.
Keep StarEmbed as a diagnostic input experiment only until split integrity is resolved.
Keep DR24 HATS and Zubercal as separate source products.
Keep CIN optional and outside the Park MVP critical path.
Do not merge or release without explicit authorization and verified acceptance.
